description:
INNOVATIVE LEAN METHOD FOR GAZIANTEP INDUSTRY: A NEW MODEL FOR ONLINE ENGLISH EDUCATION

In today’s globalized world, foreign language proficiency has become a crucial factor directly influencing the competitiveness of individuals and institutions, particularly in the business sector. Gaziantep, one of Türkiye’s most prominent industrial and commercial cities, stands out with its strong production capacity and entrepreneurial potential. However, despite this dynamic structure, academic and practical research on Business English in the region has remained limited, revealing a significant gap at both regional and national levels.

This book is the outcome of a scientific research project conducted through a collaboration between Gaziantep University and an internationally active private company, aiming to address this gap. The study systematically examines, for the first time, the Business English needs of business professionals and employees in Gaziantep and presents the effectiveness of a distance education program designed based on the Lean Educational Method.

Throughout the research process, pre-tests, needs analyses, instructional implementations, and post-tests were conducted in accordance with scientific principles, and the collected data were supported by statistical analyses. In this respect, the book goes beyond being a purely theoretical resource and offers a directly applicable educational model. It also serves as a valuable guide for researchers and practitioners working in the fields of adult education, Business English instruction, and online learning. It is hoped that this work will inspire further studies on foreign language education in the business world and contribute to the implementation of similar practices across different regions and sectors.
